title_en: A friendly chat at a beach bar

situation.en: You're on holiday with your family in Portugal. It's late afternoon, and you're relaxing at a beach bar with a lemonade. A traveller about your age asks if the seat next to you is free, and you start chatting.
situation.he: אתם בחופשה משפחתית בפורטוגל. שעת אחר צהריים מאוחרת, ואתם נחים בבר על החוף עם לימונדה. מטיילת בערך בגילכם שואלת אם הכיסא לידכם פנוי, ואתם מתחילים לדבר.

goal.en: Start a friendly conversation with a stranger: ask and answer questions about your trips, introduce yourselves, share a tip and end the chat naturally.
goal.he: לפתוח שיחה ידידותית עם מישהי זרה: לשאול ולענות על שאלות על הטיול, להציג את עצמכם, לשתף המלצה ולסיים את השיחה בצורה טבעית.

partner_role: another traveller at a beach bar

phrases.note: Reply to 'Can I sit here?' If someone asks 'Is anyone sitting here?' or 'Is this seat taken?', start with 'No': 'No, go ahead.'

phrases.en: How long are you here for?
This is my first time in Portugal. How about you?
phrases.he: זו הפעם הראשונה שלי בפורטוגל. ומה איתך?

phrases.en: So, do you study or work back home?
Have you been to Lisbon yet?
You should definitely try the custard tarts here.
phrases.he: חייבים לטעום פה את הפסטל דה נאטה.

phrases.note: It's natural to introduce yourself after chatting for a bit, not only at the start.

phrases.en: It was really nice chatting with you.
Enjoy the rest of your trip!

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hi, sorry, is anyone sitting here?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: No, go ahead. It's a great spot for the sunset.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Thanks! It's so busy today. Are you here on vacation?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Yeah, with my family, for two weeks. I'm from Israel. How about you?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: I'm from Toronto. I'm backpacking around Europe for the summer. Portugal's my favourite so far.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: That sounds amazing. Where else have you been?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Spain and the south of France. Have you been to Lisbon yet?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Not yet, we're going on Thursday. Any tips?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Definitely try a custard tart from a local bakery, and take one of the old trams up the hill. The views are beautiful.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Great, I'll do that. I'm Noa, by the way.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Noa! I'm Sam.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too, Sam. Enjoy the sunset!

practice.partner: Hi, sorry, is this seat taken?

options.text: Yes, sit down. Nobody is sitting here.

feedback.en: Confusing: 'Yes' means the seat IS taken, but then you say nobody is sitting there. Answer the question exactly: 'No, it's free.'
feedback.he: מבלבל: yes פירושו שהכיסא תפוס, ואז אתם אומרים שאף אחד לא יושב שם. עונים בדיוק על השאלה: No, it's free.

feedback.en: Friendly and natural. 'Go ahead' invites them to sit down.
feedback.he: ידידותי וטבעי. Go ahead מזמין לשבת.

options.text: No, it is not taken. You can sit.

feedback.en: Correct, but it sounds stiff. Contractions (it's) and 'Go ahead' sound warmer.
feedback.he: תקין, אבל נשמע נוקשה. קיצורים (it's) ו-Go ahead נשמעים חמים יותר.

practice.partner: So, are you here on vacation too?

options.text: Yeah, with my family for two weeks. What about you?

feedback.en: Answers briefly and asks back, which is the key to keeping small talk going.
feedback.he: עונה בקצרה ושואל בחזרה, וזה הסוד לשיחת חולין שזורמת.

options.text: Yes, I am in vacation with my family since two weeks.

feedback.en: Two errors: 'on vacation' (not 'in'), and 'for two weeks' (not 'since'). 'Since' needs a starting point: since Monday.
feedback.he: שתי טעויות: on vacation ולא in, ו-for two weeks ולא since. אחרי since באה נקודת התחלה: since Monday.

feedback.en: True, but one word can make you seem uninterested, even if you're just shy. Add a detail and ask a question back.
feedback.he: נכון, אבל מילה אחת עלולה לגרום לכם להיראות לא מעוניינים, גם אם אתם פשוט ביישנים. הוסיפו פרט ושאלו בחזרה.

model_replies: Yeah, with my family for two weeks. What about you?
Yes, we're here for two weeks. How about you?

practice.partner: I'm from Toronto. I've been backpacking around Europe for a month.

options.text: Nice. I never was in Canada.

feedback.en: Friendly, but 'I never was' should be 'I've never been' (present perfect for life experience). It also turns the topic back to you; a question about her trip works better.
feedback.he: ידידותי, אבל במקום I never was צריך I've never been (present perfect לניסיון חיים). וזה גם מחזיר את השיחה אליכם; שאלה על הטיול שלה עדיפה.

options.text: How much costs a trip like that?

feedback.en: Wrong word order: 'How much does a trip like that cost?' And asking about money is too personal with someone you've just met.
feedback.he: סדר מילים שגוי: How much does a trip like that cost? וחוץ מזה, שאלה על כסף אישית מדי מול מישהו שזה עתה הכרתם.

options.text: Wow, a whole month! What's been the best place so far?

feedback.en: Shows real interest and asks an open question, so the other person can talk.
feedback.he: מראה עניין אמיתי ושואל שאלה פתוחה, שמזמינה את הצד השני לספר.

model_replies: Wow, a whole month! What's been the best place so far?
That sounds amazing. Where else have you been?

practice.partner: Have you been to Lisbon yet?

options.text: Not yet. We're going on Thursday. Anything I shouldn't miss?

feedback.en: 'Not yet' is the natural short answer, 'we're going' is right for a fixed plan, and asking for tips keeps the chat going.
feedback.he: Not yet היא התשובה הקצרה והטבעית, we're going מתאים לתוכנית שכבר נקבעה, ובקשת המלצה ממשיכה את השיחה.

options.text: No, not yet. We go there Thursday with my parents and my little brother.

feedback.en: Understandable, but for a fixed plan use the present continuous: 'We're going on Thursday.' The family detail is friendly, but a question back, like 'Any tips?', would keep the chat going better.
feedback.he: מובן, אבל לתוכנית שכבר נקבעה משתמשים בהווה מתמשך: We're going on Thursday. הפרט על המשפחה ידידותי, אבל שאלה בחזרה כמו Any tips? תמשיך את השיחה טוב יותר.

feedback.en: 'Didn't been' mixes two tenses. Say 'Not yet' or 'No, I haven't been there yet.'
feedback.he: didn't been מערבב שני זמנים. אומרים Not yet או No, I haven't been there yet.

model_replies: Not yet. We're going on Thursday. Anything I shouldn't miss?
No, not yet. We're going there at the end of the week. Any tips?

practice.partner: Anyway, my friends are waving at me. It was really nice talking to you!

feedback.en: Not wrong, but it sounds cold after a friendly chat. Return the compliment first: 'You too!'
feedback.he: לא שגוי, אבל נשמע קר אחרי שיחה נעימה. קודם מחזירים מחמאה: You too!

options.text: Wait, give me your Instagram before you go, so we can talk later.

feedback.en: 'Give me' sounds like an order, and stopping someone who is leaving can feel pushy. A friendly chat on holiday doesn't need contact details: a warm goodbye ('You too! Enjoy your trip!') is enough.
feedback.he: Give me נשמע כמו פקודה, ולעצור מישהו שכבר הולך עלול להרגיש לוחץ. שיחה נעימה בחופשה לא דורשת פרטי קשר: פרידה חמה (You too! Enjoy your trip!) מספיקה.

options.text: You too! Enjoy the rest of your trip!

feedback.en: 'You too' returns the compliment, and the good wishes end the chat warmly.
feedback.he: You too מחזיר את המחמאה, והאיחול מסיים את השיחה בחום.

model_replies: You too! Enjoy the rest of your trip!
Same here! Have a great time in Lisbon.

roleplay.persona: Sam, a friendly 19-year-old woman from Toronto who is backpacking around Europe for the summer. She's easy-going, curious and a little talkative, and uses casual North American English ('awesome', 'for sure', 'super').
roleplay.complication: Sam mishears where the learner is from (she thinks they said 'Italy', not 'Israel') and starts talking about Italian food, so the learner must politely correct her. Later she asks for one place worth visiting in the learner's country, which the learner must describe briefly.
roleplay.opening_line: Hey, sorry, is anyone sitting here? It's packed today!

culture.en: Small talk with strangers usually stays on safe topics: travel, food, the weather, music, sport. With someone you've just met, avoid money, politics and religion.
culture.he: שיחת חולין עם זרים נשארת בדרך כלל בנושאים בטוחים: טיולים, אוכל, מזג אוויר, מוזיקה וספורט. מול מישהו שזה עתה הכרתם, עדיף להימנע מכסף, פוליטיקה ודת.

culture.en: Asking a question back ('How about you?', 'What about you?') is essential. One-word answers can make you seem uninterested, even if you're just shy.
culture.he: חשוב מאוד לשאול בחזרה (How about you?, What about you?). תשובות של מילה אחת עלולות לגרום לכם להיראות לא מעוניינים, גם אם אתם רק ביישנים.

culture.en: Be friendly but sensible: chat in public places, don't share where you're staying, and never feel you have to swap numbers or social media.
culture.he: היו ידידותיים אבל זהירים: שוחחו במקומות ציבוריים, אל תשתפו איפה אתם מתאכסנים, ואל תרגישו מחויבים להחליף מספרי טלפון או רשתות חברתיות.
